model: ROLEX Datejust 41 126333 (41 mm steel and yellow-gold Rolesor, yellow-gold fluted bezel, slate dial with green Roman numerals, Cyclops date, Jubilee bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Datejust 41 template follower: 126333 (Rolesor yellow, slate dial with green Roman numerals, Jubilee): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 74 real flutes (148 flat facets with the photo's zig-zag in / out outline), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, traced hand outlines, fluted crown and the three-column Jubilee bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, indices, print, date numeral, rehaut engraving and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.215 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 905, lug bottom y 1980, crown rows take the mirrored left flank); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..147 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (odd k: one is exactly at 9 o'clock) reach r 17.41..20.06 mm, short ones 17.59..19.90 mm; flange 15.98..17.08 mm

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.6 x 5.9 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, black facets and polished edges stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Datejust crown (no guards): flutes x 1409..1459, cap to 1474, axis 0.52 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: Jubilee bracelet (brushed steel outer links, three equal polished yellow-gold columns semi / centre / semi, about 3 mm each): column lines x 860 / 926.6 / 993.1 / 1059.6 px (gradient maxima of row bands 690..720, 830..860 top, 2060..2100, 2380..2410 bottom). Outer joints (px, pivot (960, 1424), 22.215 px/mm): top 904(lug) / 807 / 730 / 685 / 674 end; bottom 1980(lug) / 2107 / 2227 / 2331.5 / 2422 / 2490 / 2526 end (sharp edges of the overlapping links, gradient maxima on x 790..850 / 1070..1130). Gold semi and centre links: joints at the centres of the dark gap runs (luminance < 70, column band +-14 px) beside each polished block, listed in the pieces (left and right semi columns are identical); the small strips between the blocks are their own short pieces. Gold ends 673.5 / 674 top and 2530 bottom.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
